Subject: Growth program holdback — ready to submit docs

Hi Neha —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We're excited about the Growth program credit offer, and I wanted to get the required paperwork started so we can unblock the promotional credits that are currently in holdback. Per the agreement, we should submit the items below:

- Latest cap table (PDF)
- Confirmation of company stage and demo assets (single screen capture ok)
- Signed MOP (mutual operational provisions) with billing contact

I've attached the cap table and a screenshot of the dashboard we plan to demo. The signed MOP needs a quick initialing — attaching a scanned copy as well. Let me know if anything else is needed for verification.

Best,
Sarah Park
Head of Partnerships, HatchLabs
attachments: [hatchlabs_cap_table.pdf, project-mvp-screenshot.png, signed-mop.pdf]

Thanks Sarah — quick note on process so we stay aligned:

1) I need the cap table PDF to show current ownership and any recent converts (the file you attached looks like the right doc, I'll run it by finance).
2) Marissa will confirm product fit and demo acceptance — if the screenshot is representative we're good for the product check.
3) Karthik/Finance need the billing contact and the signed MOP with the initials on page 2. If you can confirm the invoice email for finance, we'll route release request.

If all checks pass we can trigger a partial credit release (50% of the promo allocation) while we finish the compliance audit. Final release requires completed onboarding metrics within 30 days.

Can you confirm the billing contact and whether there are any outstanding convertible notes that affected cap since the PDF snapshot?

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Strategic Growth, Redwood Inference

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the checklist. Quick answers:

- Billing contact: billing@hatchlabs.com (same as finance@hatchlabs.com)
- No converts since file creation; the only outstanding SAFE is documented on page 3 of the cap table (not dilutive yet).
- Initials on page 2 of the MOP are visible on the scan — but we've also uploaded an e-signed copy to your Drive link (see HubSpot note).

We'd appreciate the partial release while you complete the compliance check — the team needs runway to finalize the integration demo next week.

On a related note: can you confirm whether the Growth credits can be used against Dedicated instances during the trial window? That affects how we plan usage.

Best,

- Product validated the demo screenshot as sufficient for our product check.
- We can approve a 50% provisional credit release (promo code: GROW-PARTIAL-50) to be applied to hosted plan usage. The credits are not eligible for Dedicated capacity by policy; please advise HatchLabs to consume on hosted endpoints during the trial.
